title: Expectation of a random vector
statement: Let $\Xi$ be a finite set, let $V$ be a real normed vector space, let $\mu$ be a probability mass function on $\Xi$, and let $f\colon\Xi\to V$. Define the vector expectation by $\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\mu}[f(x)]=\sum_{x\in\Xi}\mu(x)f(x)$, where the sum uses scalar multiplication in $V$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a real normed vector space
$\mu$ is a probability mass function on $\Xi$
